title: Makhana – Premium Lotus Seeds | Natural Superfood Snack
descriptionHtml:
Buy Premium Mithila Makhana Online in India

Shop GrassCrafts Premium Makhana, also known as phool makhana, fox nuts or lotus seeds, sourced from the Mithila region of Bihar, India. These traditional lotus seeds are packed plain for you to roast, season and enjoy your way.

Why choose GrassCrafts makhana?

  • Plain and simple: no added oil, salt, sugar or preservatives.
  • Versatile snack: roast at home, add your favourite seasoning, or use in kheer and curries.
  • Traditional Mithila sourcing: sourced from the Mithila region of Bihar.
  • Resealable, food-safe pouch: helps keep the product stored neatly after opening.
  • Retail and gifting: suitable for home pantries, festive hampers, wedding gifts and corporate gifting enquiries.

Choose your makhana pack size

Available in 100 g, 250 g, 500 g and 1 kg pack options. Larger packs offer a lower price per 100 g based on the current listed prices. Check the size selector above for the latest price and availability. Makhana packs of 250 g and larger ship free across India, with no minimum order. The 100 g pack ships free on orders of ₹1,299 and above (₹120 below that).

How to prepare and store makhana

Dry-roast over low heat for around 5–8 minutes until crisp, or prepare with your preferred seasoning. Store in a cool, dry place and reseal the pouch after opening. Best before 6 months from the date of packaging.

Frequently asked questions about makhana

What is makhana also called?

Makhana is commonly called phool makhana, fox nuts or lotus seeds. GrassCrafts offers plain makhana sourced from the Mithila region of Bihar.

Is this roasted or flavoured makhana?

No. This is plain makhana with no added oil, salt, sugar or preservatives. Roast it at home and add seasoning to your preference.

Which pack sizes can I buy?

Choose from 100 g, 250 g, 500 g and 1 kg. Current prices and availability are shown in the size selector on this page.

How should I store makhana after opening?

Keep it in a cool, dry place and reseal the pouch after opening. Refer to the packaging for the best-before date.

Can I order makhana for gifts or in bulk?

Yes. GrassCrafts can help with bulk orders for retail, festive hampers, weddings and corporate gifting. Availability, customisation and lead time depend on the order; contact us for a quote.

Bulk, wholesale and corporate gifting

Looking to buy makhana in bulk for retail, festive hampers, weddings or corporate gifts? Order the 5 kg bulk pack, the makhana gift hamper in a Sabai grass basket, or contact GrassCrafts through our wholesale and corporate gifting page or WhatsApp +91 62907 44782.

title: Handwoven Cane Planters | 4 Designs | Small, Medium, Large & Sets
descriptionHtml:
Not everything worth having is made quickly. This wasn't.

In a sunlit workshop somewhere in India, a master artisan picks up a strand of freshly harvested cane and begins. Over the next 5–7 hours, strand by strand, the planter takes shape — tight, balanced, alive. No machine can replicate this. No algorithm can replace the hands that made it.

A Material That Gives Back to the Earth

Cane is one of nature's most remarkable materials. It grows fast, requires no pesticides, and actively absorbs CO₂ as it matures — making it a carbon-negative raw material before it even reaches your home.

  • 100% natural cane — zero plastics, zero resins, zero toxins
  • Biodegradable at end of life — returns to the earth as it came
  • Harvested sustainably from managed groves
  • Each piece supports a living craft tradition and fair artisan livelihoods

When you choose this planter, you reduce your home's carbon footprint — not as a compromise, but as an upgrade.

Designed for Considered Living

This is a planter for homes where every object has been chosen, not collected. Whether it anchors a trailing monstera in your Pali Hill drawing room, frames a sculptural cactus on your Golf Links windowsill, or holds a lush fern in your Sadashivanagar study — it belongs.

The tight weave catches light beautifully. The earthy tone grounds any palette. It pairs with linen, stone, raw wood, aged brass, and silence.

Available in Four Sizes

  • Small: Height 8", Diameter 8"
  • Medium: Height 10", Diameter 10"
  • Large: Height 12", Diameter 12"
  • Set of 3: One of each — Small, Medium & Large — for a curated, layered look

A quiet act of sustainability. A piece of India’s living craft heritage. A gift that means something — for a housewarming, a birthday, or simply yourself.

Quick answers

What are the planters made of?
100% natural cane, handwoven by artisans; each planter takes 5-7 hours to weave.

What sizes are available?
Small (8 in high, 8 in diameter), Medium (10 x 10 in), Large (12 x 12 in) and a Set of 3 with one of each.
